common_symptoms: fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, stiff neck, confusion, convulsions, muscle aches, joint pain
complications: meningitis, sepsis, miscarriage, stillbirth, neonatal death
sequelae: neurological damage, cognitive impairment, hearing loss
epidemiology: rare in healthcare settings, more common in immunocompromised patients
risk_factors: immunosuppression, pregnancy, advanced age, underlying medical conditions
preventive_measures: hand hygiene, sterilization of equipment, proper food handling and storage
diagnosis_challenges: non-specific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers
treatment_challenges: resistant strains, side effects, poor adherence
